proposed_widenings.name: grant_environmental_temperature_immunity
proposed_widenings.justification: The item prevents harm from a bounded environmental temperature condition, including protection for the wearer and carried/worn gear. That is neither damage resistance nor incoming-damage reduction, and no existing passive atom models environmental cold immunity.
proposed_widenings.evidence: while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower

notes: Top-level fit exists as a magic_item with passive mechanics and attunement. The first clause is encodable today as a wearing-gated reduce_damage_taken effect against cold damage, but authoring only that clause would be incomplete and therefore dishonest. I did not author content/tracer files.
